name: SIM Swap / Unauthorized eSIM Fraud
ncrpCategory: Telecom / Identity Cyber Crime -> SIM Swap Fraud
summary: Fraudsters obtain an unauthorized duplicate physical SIM or initiate an unapproved eSIM transfer to intercept SMS OTPs, hijack WhatsApp accounts, and execute banking transactions in the victim's name.
rules: If your mobile phone suddenly loses cellular signal and displays 'No Service' unexpectedly, investigate immediately.
Never forward telecom verification SMS or share eSIM configuration QR codes with third parties.
initialActionChecklist: Immediately contact your telecom service provider customer care from an alternate phone to block the swapped SIM.
Contact your primary banks immediately to freeze Netbanking, UPI, and debit cards linked to the compromised mobile number.
Dial 1930 immediately if any unauthorized debits have already taken place on your bank accounts.
Visit the nearest authorized telecom operator store with original government ID to reclaim your physical SIM.
Check email accounts linked to the phone number for password reset alerts and enable app-based 2FA.
evidenceRequired: Exact timestamp when cellular network signal was lost on the device
Telecom SMS or email notifications regarding SIM upgrade / eSIM transfer request
Bank statements showing any unauthorized transactions carried out during the network outage
Telecom customer support service request / ticket numbers
source: Department of Telecommunications (DoT) & RBI Advisory on SIM Swap Fraud
